scientific_integrity: A new rank-homogeneous odd majority-fibre construction with an invariant counting probability. Original source facts are separately attributed; new normalization, recurrence, infinite degree integral, and certificate optimality are proved in RESULT.md. No claim of independent validation or priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Maximum degree is unbounded; this does not resolve the bounded-maximum-degree Borel unfriendly-colouring problem.
Weight minimality is for the specified odd rank-homogeneous, unit-leaf strict-parent-majority certificate class, not arbitrary graphs or constructions.
The invariant probability has infinite average degree, so the positive finite-cost theorem does not apply.
Independent audit has not been performed.
title: Invariant unfriendly-colouring obstruction from Fibonacci-sized majority fibres
